Class PlotRecorder

java.lang.Object
com.eco.bio7.spatial.PlotRecorder
public class PlotRecorder extends Object
Records a plot of the plot API (see Plot3D) frame by frame, e.g., a plot which is updated in each step of a simulation (see Plot3D.update), and exports the recording to an HTML page with WebGL: the plot with the axes, the title and the legends of each frame, Play/Pause, a timeline, the speed and a loop (the view can be rotated and zoomed while the recording plays) or for Blender as an animation (see exportBlender). 
PlotRecorder recorder = new PlotRecorder().speed(10);
for (int t = 0; t < 100; t++) {
        step(); // the model
        plot.clearLayers().add(Plot3D.scatter(x, y, z)).update();
        recorder.frame(plot);
}
recorder.export("/path/recording.html");

    • exportBlender

      public String exportBlender(String file) throws IOException
      Exports the recording for Blender as an animation: a glTF file (*.glb) with the objects of all frames (an object which doesn't change is exported once) and a Python script with the same name (*.py) which imports the file and animates the visibility of the objects and the texts (the frames 1 ... n of the timeline of Blender with the speed of the recording), e.g., to render a film. In Blender: Scripting - Open - Run Script.
      Parameters:
      file - the glTF file (*.glb), the script is written next to it
      Returns:
      the path of the Python script
      Throws:
      IOException - if a file cannot be written
